acceptable_hypotheses: Redis timeouts appeared after initial delivery delays.
contributing_factors: Later Redis timeouts were limited and not the initial symptom.
corrective_actions: Monitor delivery receipts and oldest-message age.
expected_findings: Delivery age and queue depth rose after the concurrency change.
Green broker health did not establish healthy consumer throughput.

expected_timeline.event: Broker health is green but lag is not shown

resolution_details: Consumer concurrency was restored and queue age and delivery receipts were monitored.
